card.name: Notes and disclaimers on web pages
card.fires_on: Small words right after a web-page notice opener such as "Note:" or "Please note", or inside a condition clause like "If no author is given". Also the word "format" in "(pdf format)".

modes.label: Note or disclaimer lead-in
modes.description: The word "If", "that" or "in" right after "Note:", "Please note" or a link disclaimer.
modes.example: Please note<< that>> this Creative Commons license applies to text

modes.label: pdf format tag
modes.description: The word "format" inside a parenthetical file-type label for a link.
modes.example: Universal Waste Management Companies (pdf<< format>>) can ensure your used electronics are handled

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and mostly unrelated to the text.
card.plain: It fires on the small words that begin a website's fine-print notice, such as "Note: If" or "Please note that".
